title: Unsafe call to `ERC20::transfer` can result in stuck funds
summary: ## Proof of Concept  In the `_sendFunds` method we have the following code for transferring ERC20 tokens  ```solidity IERC20(underlyingToken).transfer(receiver, amount); ```  The problem is that the `transfer` function from ERC20 returns a bool to indicate if the transfer was a success or not. As there are some tokens that do not revert on failure but instead return `false` (one such example is [ZRX](https://etherscan.io/address/0xe41d2489571d322189246dafa5ebde1f4699f498#code)) and also Zerem should work with all types of ERC20 tokens since it might be integrated with a protocol that does that
